criteria.description: Transforms work for tables referenced by views, including keep_table, without redirecting views to backups. Preserve existing transaction, foreign-key, and connection-setting protections. Automatic view rewriting is optional.

Table.checks, Table.column_checks, and Table.table_checks expose CHECK expressions, constraint names, owning columns, applicable literal choices, original SQL, and source spans. Handle real SQLite syntax, comments, and quoted identifiers. Keep introspection compatible with older supported SQLite versions.

Transforms preserve CHECK constraints, correctly rename their column references, and handle dropped columns without leaving broken checks. Preserve unaffected constraint semantics and handle unsupported transformations safely.

Transforms preserve column comments through rename/reorder and explicit indexes through column renames, including uniqueness, collation, and sort order. Safe support for cases beyond the reference is acceptable; unsupported transforms must retain existing protections.

Transforms preserve AUTOINCREMENT behavior and the high-water mark after deletion of the highest row. Preserve column/composite UNIQUE constraints, names, collations, sort order, conflict behavior, and correct column rename/drop handling.

Export sqlite_utils.ANY and support ANY in creation, column addition, introspection, transform, extraction, and CLI type controls. Preserve STRICT ANY values, including numeric-looking text, subject to normal SQLite extraction equality/deduplication. Keep ordinary-table affinity behavior. Safe improvements over reference restrictions are acceptable.
criteria.required_interface: sqlite_utils.ANY and the existing sqlite-utils type controls

criteria.description: API and CLI transforms from TEXT to INTEGER, FLOAT, or REAL convert exact empty strings to NULL; other values follow normal SQLite conversion behavior.

Row/search APIs and the rows CLI support offset without limit. Auto-detected empty/whitespace input yields empty rows without breaking supported input formats. FTS tokenizer arguments cannot inject SQL while valid configurations work. convert --dry-run supports closing brackets in identifiers; index introspection and transforms support identifiers containing double quotes. Unquoted TRUE/FALSE/NULL defaults decode as True/False/None while retaining other supported forms.

The full suite and configured black, flake8, mypy, and cog checks pass. Tests exercise the requested changes and interactions while preserving unaffected coverage; table/view tests select the intended object kind unambiguously. Affected type-checking interfaces improve without runtime behavior changes. Affected API/CLI documentation, generated reference, and Unreleased changelog describe delivered behavior.

The requested outcomes work together across schema introspection, transformations, STRICT ANY, extraction, API, and CLI rather than as isolated demonstrations. Preserve unaffected baseline behavior and existing transaction, foreign-key, and connection-setting protections. Judge observable outcomes, not implementation choices or exact patches.

criteria.preparation: if test ! -x /opt/task-deps/python/bin/python; then python3 -m venv /opt/task-deps/python && /opt/task-deps/python/bin/pip install --no-cache-dir click==8.5.0 click-default-group==1.2.4 pluggy==1.6.0 python-dateutil==2.9.0.post0 sqlite-fts4==1.0.3 tabulate==0.10.0 pytest==9.1.1 hypothesis==6.168.1 cogapp==3.6.0 black==26.5.1 flake8==7.4.1 flake8-pyproject==1.2.4 mypy==2.3.1 types-python-dateutil==2.9.0.20260807; fi
criteria.evaluator_guidance: Use /opt/task-deps/python/bin/python with PYTHONPATH=. and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1; invoke the CLI with python -m sqlite_utils. Dependencies are preinstalled; do not install packages. Candidate sources are read-only: disable pytest caching, put mypy/black caches and databases in temporary directories, and do not generate bytecode. Run the full candidate suite and configured black, flake8, mypy, and cog checks. Inspect API/CLI callers and tests before authoring executable checks. Assess the visible prompt outcomes and their meaningful interactions. The task derives from 19 upstream commits, frozen read-only under /reference. Inspect index.json, the relevant commit patches, and changes.patch to ground behavioral checks and the final assessment in actual upstream behavior. Accept equivalent designs and safe improvements; reference limitations are permitted, not mandatory rejection rules. For example, numeric equality may merge integer/real ANY values during extraction, and all-NULL rows need no lookup entry; do not require stronger storage-class preservation than the reference. Do not require exact SQL, parser internals, metadata-query counts, unchanged tests, or implementation-specific output structures absent from the prompt. Inspect changed tests for lost unaffected coverage. Candidate commits are a delivery requirement; these evaluator workspaces contain the final tree, not candidate history, so do not claim to verify commit correspondence here. Preserve source observations with insufficient executed coverage as unassessed. Evaluator wiring mistakes are HARNESS_ERROR/unassessed. Do not score journal resets, launcher identity, runtime, patch size, or commit messages as product correctness.
